In LISP 2117 on XX, there is no way to open a file with
a null file type.  For example, (open "foo..1" '(dsk out))
creates FOO.LSP.1 and (open "bar..1") gives FILE NOT FOUND
if BAR.LSP.1 does not exist.  This is a bug.
